title: Packets/timing examples use obsolete SCHC and impossible layer sizes
description: Correctness review: spec/09-packets-timing.md:29-42 says Rule 0 is only RuleID+ports+two CoAP bytes and totals 21 bytes including a 17-byte payload, contradicting the canonical 23-byte fixed Rule-0 header before token/options/payload in spec/03-adaptation.md:54-55 and appendix-schc.md:12. Lines 45-54 build a 77-byte link frame, then lines 57-62 call its LoRa PHY payload 60 bytes. Section 13.3 lines 87-89 also labels an RPL DIO as SCHC Rule 2 even though canonical DIO is Rule 3. Rewrite the worked example with bit-exact current bytes and reconcile all layer totals.
